metadata.Description: The theory, creation, and use of text-based search engines are covered in this lecture-based course. The main content includes experimental assessment, representation of information demands and documents, several significant retrieval models, and statistical features of the text. Besides, the course covers typical components of commercial search engines, such as federated search, vertical search, tailored search results, and diversified search results.

clos.CLO Details: Understanding how search engines work: Students should be able to explain the underlying technology behind search engines, including the algorithms used to crawl, index and rank web pages.
Search engine optimization: Students should be able to apply best practices for optimizing web pages to improve their visibility in search engine results pages (SERPs).
Keyword research: Students should be able to conduct keyword research to identify the most relevant and profitable keywords by using popular retrieval models..
Analytics and tracking: Students should be able to use analytics tools to track website traffic, user behavior, and campaign performance.
Solving problems: Students should be able to apply search engine techniques to solve the real-life problems

clos.CLO Details: Students will develop a solid understanding of the fundamental concepts and principles of text mining, including techniques for extracting, transforming, and analyzing textual data.
Students can use machine learning/deep learning (neural networks, neural language models, recurrent neural networks, LSMT) for specific text-mining applications.

Students will explore the methods and algorithms used for text classification and clustering tasks. They will learn to apply techniques like Naive Bayes, Support Vector Machines, and k-means clustering.

Students will learn about different methods for representing text data, such as bag-of-words, term frequency-inverse document frequency (TF-IDF), and word embeddings. They will understand the strengths and limitations of each approach.
Students will be aware of the popular applications in text mining, such as machine translation, question answering, and chatbots to design text mining-related applications in real-world

metadata.Description: This speech processing course comprehensively explains how humans and machines generate, transmit, and process speech signals. The course covers speech production, phonetics, acoustic analysis, speech perception, speech recognition, natural language processing, and speech synthesis. Students will learn about the principles and algorithms behind various speech-processing techniques, including signal processing, machine learning, and deep learning. The course also covers speech processing applications in speech recognition, speech recognition, speech synthesis, and speech enhancement. Upon completing the course, students will have a solid foundation in speech processing and be equipped with the necessary skills to tackle real-world speech-processing problems.

metadata.Syllabus Name: Image and Video processing_Xử lý ảnh và video
metadata.Learning-Teaching Method: In-class lecture, Social Constructivism, Active Learning
metadata.Time Allocation: 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
metadata.Description: Image & Video Processing is an advanced course that covers the fundamental principles, techniques, and applications of image and video processing. The course explores manipulating digital images and videos to extract useful information, enhance visual quality, and perform analysis. It covers various topics, including image acquisition and digitization, image enhancement and restoration, image compression and coding, image segmentation and feature extraction, and object recognition and tracking. The course also covers fundamental concepts in video processing, including video coding and compression, motion estimation, and video analysis. Students will learn to process images and videos using various tools and software platforms, including MATLAB and Python.

clos.CLO Details: Gain a comprehensive understanding of fundamental principles in image and video processing, digital signal processing in time domain and frequency domain
Develop expertise in applying the tradditional and machine learning-based techniques for image and video acquisition, digitization, enhancement, restoration.
Develop expertise in applying traditional and machine learning based methods to compress images and video
Acquire practical skills by using and implementing traditional and machine learning based tools to segment and extract features of an image
Develop expertise in applying traditional and machine learning based methods in object detection, motion estimation and video analysis.
